newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei finishes at fresh high for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei finishes at fresh high for 1997.

text.p: The Tokyo Nikkei index finished at a high for 1997 for the second consecutive day, as buying of high-tech laggards, semiconducter-related shares and some issues driven by domestic demand provided support, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average ended 48.40 points or 0.24 percent higher at 20,611.56. Its June futures shed 10 points to close at 20,550.
"Foreign investors absorbed the profit-taking moves by domestic institutional investors and propped up the indices," said Kenji Karikomi at Daiwa Securities.
